notes.reason: LaCorte never says the caliphate fell in October 2019. Earlier in the same video he dates it correctly: 'The end came in March 2019 in a filthy tent camp on a river near a village called Baghouz.' The sentence the note attacks is a caption without commas, and the natural reading is 'Seven months after losing the last of the caliphate, in October 2019, American special forces cornered al-Baghdadi', where October 2019 is when Baghdadi was cornered. That reading is exactly right: Baghuz fell on 23 March 2019 and Baghdadi died on 26-27 October 2019, which is seven months. The note therefore picks the one parsing that makes the host wrong, contradicts what he plainly said two minutes earlier, and corrects an error he did not make. This is the misquote failure Andy Masley already complained about, and LaCorte, who twice invites corrections but says 'if I make any substantive mistake here', would read it as us not having watched the video.
